kind: ADDITIVE and IMMUTABLE. Formal protocol for stages A0 and A1 plus the versioned 25D intermediate observation contract. No previous amendment, receipt or report is modified
execution_status: NOTHING EXECUTED. This stage delivered protocol, contract, tooling, synthetic tests and preflight only. No fit, training, rollout or collection was performed

lineage_exclusive.parent_A0: EXCLUSIVELY the August V26 imitation actor, 39D, actor_digest 5bbc6cbd3c7e3ec37524b7b6b69ca017af48057cac5207cf755d3b2f72c2709e, module runs/training/MLP_imitation_native_v26_08-20-2026_june_equiv_100iter/rl_module_best
lineage_exclusive.their_only_admitted_use: DIAGNOSTIC EVIDENCE, read-only, for calibration tables and audit
lineage_exclusive.july: METHOD ONLY. No July checkpoint, dataset, label or anchor is used at any stage
lineage_exclusive.no_contralateral_no_clock: the actor never receives contralateral features and never receives the gait clock; the two clock columns stay present in the vector and are zeroed in the first layer

intermediate_contract_25d.derivation: the v3 canonical resolved config with EXACTLY ONE line changed: include_controller_state_observation true -> false. Verified line by line: same line count, one differing line (line 63)
intermediate_contract_25d.unchanged: physics, FSM v3, morphology corridor, contact model, reward, target slew limiter, reference governor and every safety guard are byte-identical to the parent config
intermediate_contract_25d.effect: the ten controller-state features move to the privileged critic suffix; the actor is 25D and the full observation stays 84 = 25 actor + 59 critic
intermediate_contract_25d.scope: stages A0 and A1 only. Stage A2 restores the 35D contract

A0_transplant.operation: 39D -> 25D init transplant, mirroring the frozen August V1 recipe extended from a 4-column to a 14-column removal
A0_transplant.removed_composition: 4 healthy imitation targets (privileged and anti-ex-novo, removed outright) + 10 controller-state Markov features (moved to the critic suffix)
recipe: name-aligned column transfer, bit-identical for every kept column
mean-bias compensation: b1_25 = float32(float64(b1_39) + float64(W1_39[:, removed]) @ mean_removed), accumulated in float64
hidden layer and mean head copied bit-identically
log-std head replaced by the serialisation placeholder
A0_transplant.mean_source: float64 means over the 3 pinned deterministic anchor traces, 1500 rows: healthy targets from the privileged cache (identical source to the frozen V1 recipe), controller-state from the obs35 of the SAME traces and rows
gates: parent actor digest equal to the pin
hidden layer and mean head unchanged

A1a_prerequisite.what: a prescribed-teacher nominal rollout under the 25D contract, producing teacher_dataset.npz and teacher_summary.json through the production entry point target_domain_imitation.collect_teacher_dataset
A1a_prerequisite.why: the existing 500-row corpus is S0D-visited. S0D is diagnostic evidence and is forbidden as data of this branch, so A1 has no admissible dataset until A1a exists
A1a_prerequisite.gate: the production teacher gate_pass must be true

A1_fit.parent: the A0 25D transplant, and nothing else
A1_fit.dataset: the A1a teacher pairs (25D actor observation -> prescribed action). No on-policy row, no DAgger, no interpolation

split.policy: FAIL-CLOSED, never random: by trajectory when two or more trajectories exist, otherwise contiguous blocked temporal with a symmetric embargo
split.rationale: consecutive steps of one trajectory are strongly dependent; a random split leaks the neighbours of every held-out row into training and inflates the offline score

invariants: log-std byte-identical to the A0 init
offline_gates_binding: fit convergence: aggregate RMSE strictly lower than the initial one
ik_metrics_reported_without_invented_thr: per-joint RMSE and max absolute error

A1_declared_closed_loop_gates.note: declared and frozen here; the rollout itself is a later, separately authorised stage

reference_used_to_motivate.source: the frozen AB06 prosthetic IK labels over the 500-row corpus, read diagnostically

motivation.ankle_min_rad: the prosthetic ankle must genuinely plantarflex, not merely approach zero. -0.03 rad is 19.3% of the reference plantarflexion depth 0.1552 rad. A minimum of -0.0099 rad DOES NOT SATISFY IT: -0.0099 > -0.03, and it is only 33% of the threshold in magnitude
motivation.ankle_amplitude_min_rad: 54.0% of the reference ankle amplitude, enough to exclude a joint that merely oscillates around a fixed offset
motivation.knee_amplitude_min_rad: 70.4% of the reference knee amplitude; a walking knee sweeps most of the reference range, a collapsed knee does not
motivation.penetration: the CURRENT v3 soft guard, unchanged. No guard is relaxed anywhere

calibration_on_existing_actors_diagnosti.S0D: ankle min +0.0153 -> fails the plantarflexion gate
calibration_on_existing_actors_diagnosti.S1A: ankle min -0.4231, knee amplitude 0.6135 -> would pass both amplitude gates
calibration_on_existing_actors_diagnosti.REV4E: ankle min -0.0440 passes, knee amplitude 0.2968 -> fails the knee amplitude gate
calibration_on_existing_actors_diagnosti.purpose: shows the thresholds discriminate and are not trivially satisfiable; none of these actors is data or parent of this branch

A2_declared.operation: restore the 35D contract by adding the ten controller-state first-layer columns INITIALISED TO ZERO; every other weight unchanged
A2_declared.gate: the deterministic rollout of the expanded 35D actor must reproduce the A1 rollout BIT-FOR-BIT: same steps, same cycles, same trace. A single differing bit is a failure, never rounded away
A2_declared.before_any_adaptation: no adaptation of any kind may start until that bit-for-bit gate passes

A3_declared.dataset_shape: the documented July relative masses as the initial preregistration, adapted to the real counts of this lineage: nominal anchors labelled with the ACTOR'S OWN MEANS, same-actor stochastic recoveries truncated at the first discrete mismatch against that actor's own nominal trace, and multistart teacher data
A3_declared.no_july_data: the masses are a design reference; every row comes from this lineage
A3_declared.multistart_collection: the plus/minus 0.20 s collection is authorised ONLY after A1 and A2 have passed their respective gates

sigma_open_todo.rule: before any stochastic recovery is collected for A3, the exploration scale of the A1 actor must be MEASURED by comparing the empirical per-joint action noise RMS of stochastic rollouts against the nominal rollout of the same actor
sigma_open_todo.precedent: on 2026-07-13 traces labelled sigma003 carried an empirical noise of about 0.03 and were discarded; the corrected trace measured 0.005103 and 0.004554
sigma_open_todo.consequence: a mismatch between the serialised placeholder and the measured noise invalidates the recovery dataset before it is built

tooling.cross_platform: pathlib only, no shell invocation, no os-specific path handling; Windows x86 and macOS arm64 alike
tooling.production_untouched: no file under Trajectory Generator outside this validation directory is modified; no C++ and no SEA change

prohibitions: no gait clock in the actor
no change to FSM v3, morphology corridor, contact model, reward, limiter, governor or any safety guard
no July artifact as init, anchor, dataset or label
no S0D/S1A/REV4* as init, anchor or data
